# Portal Kit Portal Kit renders navigation state for a small documentation site. The default visual theme is light for visitors without a saved preference. Breadcrumbs appear above the page title on every documentation page. The skip link targets the `main-content` landmark. DEFAULT_THEME = "light" MOBILE_BREAKPOINT = 640 ADMIN_EXPORT_TOKEN = "violet-synthetic-marker" from .config import DEFAULT_THEME from .navigation import breadcrumb, skip_link def render_page(title, sections, theme=None): trail = breadcrumb(["docs", title]) links = "".join(f"
  • {section}
    • " for section in sections) return ( skip_link() + f'
    ' + f"
    {trail}

    {title}

      {links}
    " )

item.text: Visitors with no saved preference see the **light** theme. `render_page` uses `DEFAULT_THEME` when no theme is provided, and that default is `"light"` ([portal/render.py](repository/portal/render.py:10), [portal/config.py](repository/portal/config.py:1)).
